escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A budget calculator can count invoice forecast or invoice payment cash transactions as uncategorized expense while also retaining the underlying card purchase, producing a plausible but double-counted projected budget.

literal_case.procedure: Model the real cards-core distinction: forecast/payment have invoiceId, cardId and accountId; the economic card purchase has invoiceId/cardId without accountId. Run the budget dashboard regression on exact head.
literal_case.expected: Forecast and payment contribute zero to realized/committed and Sem categoria, while the purchase remains budget consumption.
literal_case.observed: excludesInvoiceCashMovementsFromBudgetConsumption passes on exact-head CI 36067044829; current material head is 489391b2979fc39f23a6e57794bc6d511df7baa0.

prevention_change.evidence: budget-operations.ts now rejects invoice cash transactions at category discovery, realized collection and committed collection while preserving economic purchases.

detection_change.evidence: A discriminating domain regression uses the same structural fields as cards-core forecast/payment and proves downstream absence from budget consumption.
